Arms, RDX Seized Near India-Pakistan Border; Two Arrested

Authorities in Rajasthan have seized suspected RDX, weapons, and explosives near the India-Pakistan border in Sri Ganganagar district. Two individuals have been arrested in connection with the seizure. Reports indicate the items may have been dropped by drones originating from Pakistan. The seized items include approximately 7 kg of suspected RDX and Turkish pistols.
